{{Tabs|History = No|Regular = Pistol Goon|Perk = Golden Pistol Goon}} {{For|[[Golden Tommy Goon 1]]|[[Golden Tommy Goon 2]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = {{Color|Golden|Golden Pistol Goon}} |image-static = GGoon1.png |image-dynamic = GoldenPistolGoonDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Golden Crook Boss]] |type = Humanoid |lifespan = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Lifespan]]200s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]40 |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]45s |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]4 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.6 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]17 |speed = 4 |hidden = N/A |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} ==Description== The '''Golden Pistol Goon''', also referred to as '''Golden Pistol Crook''', is a unit that can be spawned from the [[Golden Crook Boss]] from Level 0. It is an upgraded version of the [[Pistol Goon]], with it having a faster firerate and higher health than the [[Pistol Goon]]. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. It can detect flying enemies. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving to attack it and all other detectable enemies in its range. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. It has a 50 second spawnrate. It also spawns twice instead of once at Level 2+. There is a limit of ten '''Golden Pistol Goons''' per [[Golden Crook Boss]]. It will last 200 seconds on the map before dying. ==Appearance== The '''Golden Pistol Goon''' has tan skin. It wears a yellow shirt, black vest with golden buttons, a black tie, a brown strap with a golden buckle, brown shoes, black pants and brown belt with a golden buckle. It also has a golden watch on its right arm and black shades with translucent/opaque yellow lens. It also has a prosthetic black and golden left arm, and a black and golden helmet. [[Tower Defense Simulator Toys|Merch Shop]]Obtained by purchasing the [[Narrator Plush]]. |[[Beach Crate]] |} ==Strategy== *As it spawns from the Level 0 [[Golden Crook Boss]], the '''Golden Pistol Goon''' can be useful early on against weaker enemies like the [[Elite Abnormal]] or [[Molten]]. **While the [[Crook Boss]] itself does not have hidden or flying detection until Level 2, the '''Pistol Goon''' has it from Level 0, making it useful against hidden and flying enemies that appear early on. *The '''Golden Pistol Goon''' deals full collision damage to enemies with defense, such as the [[Hefty]] or [[Heavy]]. **As it has low damage, it is also unlikely that its damage will be reduced as an enemy needs at least 100% defense to reduce it. *On maps with multiple paths, only one/two '''Golden Pistol Goons''' spawn per [[Golden Crook Boss]]. **Each '''Golden Pistol Goon''' will go down a random path. *The '''Golden Pistol Goon''' is unaffected by buffs and debuffs. *The '''Golden Pistol Goon''' will struggle against enemies with abilities that deal damage to units because of its low health. **For example, the [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]] will quickly kill the '''Golden Pistol Goon''' if its caught in its laser. ==Trivia== *This is the third unit alongside the [[Pistol Goon]] to spawn twice at a time, the first being the [[Cannoneer Elf]] and [[Gunner Elf]]. *The '''Golden Pistol Goon''', alongside [[Pistol Goon]], was the first unit to be able to detect flying enemies. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''10 February 2024''' -
